purpose: Sarco stage-2 finite-chain boundary and size sensitivity inputs
hash_canonicalization: UTF-8/ASCII text with CRLF and CR normalized to LF
length_invariant: AN/VDCN defect count remains one while symmetric VDF host units are added
scope_limit: CNEPO is excluded because its bridging epoxide changes backbone topology and is not representable by Polyfind's pendant-fragment model

records.stereochemistry: Polyfind polymer definition; AN pendant order selects its registered isotactic enantiomer; PVDF and VDCN are achiral
records.conformation: all-trans, every constructed backbone dihedral 180 degrees
records.boundary: finite neutral H-capped single chain in vacuum

axes.y: transverse, toward the central substituted unit's non-H pendants
